name: Dulten Richard Fromentin
intro: I’m Dulten, a Grade 12 student in Brockville. I’m interested in political science, international affairs, public service, and entrepreneurship.
about: Since joining Air Cadets in 2021, I’ve spent time instructing, mentoring, and learning how to lead people. Outside cadets, I work at Value Village, play rugby, and put time into practical projects. I’m interested in what people do with an idea once it leaves the page.
quote: To be a leader is to be liquid.

employment.body: I help donors at drop-off, receive and move donated goods, support donation flow and processing, and keep the donation area organised and safe. I moved into this role from retail sales in September 2026.
Customer-facing retail work before my move into the Community Donation Centre.
I worked across food-service duties, supporting customers and the team during busy shifts.
I served customers, operated the POS, prepared food, and supported junior staff during the busy summer season.
My first paid job: serving customers, handling payments, and keeping the ice cream service area clean.

education.body: Senior mathematics and science, world studies, and practical manufacturing courses. Manufacturing SHSM complete: 18/18 requirements and 9/9 required credits.
Mock trial, school rugby, and academic study. Two Best Advocate awards and Best Closing Statement, April 2025.

training.name: Personal Training; Advanced Training in a Technique
Events Coordination; Project Management; Stress Management Techniques

projects.name: Equinox
projects.body: An approximately 22-foot sailboat, and the practical work needed to get it ready: maintenance planning, a workable budget, and summer mooring around Brockville.

steps.title: Maintenance
steps.body: Researching what needs attention and planning the work before the boat can be used.

steps.title: Budget
steps.body: Comparing the full cost of ownership, including seasonal charges, utilities, insurance, and recurring expenses.

steps.title: Mooring
steps.body: Researching Brockville-area options and contacting a marina about availability, pricing, season dates, and documentation for 2027.

projects.name: Youth Leadership Workshops
projects.status: In development · First pilot being planned
projects.body: I’m developing a business offering practical, 45–60 minute leadership workshops for youth sports teams. I’m adapting cadet peer-leadership and group-dynamics lessons into activities about communication, teamwork, and confidence.

steps.title: Lesson design
steps.body: Structured activities, cadet-style lesson planning, and simple assessment.

steps.title: First audience
steps.body: Planning around a local youth sports team. The proposed first trial is with the Brockville Braves U13–U15 boys; this is a target, not a confirmed partnership.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.body: The workshop has not yet been delivered. The first goal is to test the format and collect useful feedback.
